title: Denmark's Dual Challenge: Economic Momentum Fades as Security Spending Surges · 31 Aug
keywords: Denmark, Danish economy, GDP growth, inflation, Nationalbanken, Eurostat, defense spending, conscription, anti-drone, NATO, European Union, fiscal policy, welfare state, security policy, European defense
notes: Denmark is navigating a delicate moment, balancing a slowing but still-expanding economy against a rapid acceleration in defense and internal security spending. Quarterly growth has cooled sharply, even as the government raised its full-year outlook, while new anti-drone systems and expanded conscription signal a decisive shift in national priorities. The tension between welfare continuity and a hardening security posture is reshaping Danish politics and carries lessons for the broader European Union.
